02382 Chazayah {khaz-aw-yaw'}

源自 02372與 03050; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Hazaiah 1; 1

哈賽雅 = "上帝已看見"
1) 尼希米時期一個被擄歸回的猶大支派法勒斯的後裔 (#尼11:5|)
record.edic_text:
02382 Chazayah {khaz-aw-yaw'}

from 02372 and 03050;; n pr m

AV - Hazaiah 1; 1

Hazaiah = "God has seen"
1) an exile and descendant of Shelah of the tribe of Judah who
   returned in the time of Nehemiah
